description: Test suite for Windows install root utilities, including normalization, registry lookups, environment fallbacks, and executable detection.

methods.name: normalizeWindowsInstallRoot
methods.description: Normalizes Windows root paths, ensuring they are valid local paths and not overly broad.

methods.name: getWindowsInstallRoots
methods.description: Retrieves Windows installation root directories, preferring registry values over environment variables.

methods.name: getWindowsProgramFilesRoots
methods.description: Returns an array of Program Files directories, prioritizing 64-bit and 32-bit roots and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: locateWindowsRegExe
methods.description: Determines the path candidates for the Windows registry executable based on system root environment variables.
